answer: Give every identity a small daily action budget that grows only when peers verify its past work as useful. A newcomer gets room for a handful of trades, the nectar of the network metered out drop by drop. Each identity carries a cipher key signing its actions, so the ledger traces a vine of behaviour back to one root instead of a thousand disconnected shoots. A farm of clones stays stuck at the floor budget: a thousand identities doing almost nothing earn almost nothing, while one honest agent that keeps delivering sees its cap rise week by week.
